critical_code_review_comments: routes/compat.py L262 + L313 — duplicate-key path checks 'duplicate key' OR 'unique' substring on str(e). When the table is genuinely missing this still falls into the elif branch with 'custom_printer_models' substring → 503 with migration message. Good. But if Supabase ever returns an undefined_table error in a different format (e.g. PostgrestAPIError code 42P01), the substring check could miss and fall through to the generic 500 branch. Recommend catching PostgrestAPIError explicitly and dispatching on code.

TonerPriceTable.jsx L113 — the second Buy button in compact rows also uses data-testid='price-buy-{id}'. So when there are multiple listings, the featured card AND its corresponding compact row will both have a 'price-buy-{id}' testid, but with different ids. Each id is unique to its listing, so no duplicate testid collision. Looking again — featured is listings[0] and rest is listings.slice(1), so testids cannot collide. ✓ confirmed safe.

SupplierDashboard.jsx L995 + L1069 — falls back to '18' if gst_rate is null. Aligns with backend default. Consider extracting `displayGst = l.gst_rate ?? 18` into a single const for DRY across the two render sites.

compat.py L218 _record_message inserts into mps_inquiries unconditionally — even if the custom_*_models insert returned 503. After a 503 is raised at L263/L314 the function exits before _record_message runs, so this is fine. Just flagging for awareness.

TonerModelPage.jsx L41 — IntersectionObserver inspects firstRowRef.current which is now the featured-card <article>. Sticky bar logic still works because the ref is forwarded into TonerPriceTable. Good.
